title: core: populate Analysis.modules / module_edges in the learn pipeline
description:
[from CORE-7's handoff · exec plan: docs/v2-execution-plan.md · batch B3]
Seats: CORE-07 (learn.rs/pipeline.rs owner) + CORE-04 (modules::build author)
Gap proved by CORE-7: learn() fills variables/cfgs/types/uses but leaves Analysis.modules and Analysis.module_edges EMPTY. CORE-4 landed modules::build(&Index) -> (Vec<ModuleNode>, Vec<ModuleEdge>) but nothing calls it, so the Modules diagram (GRAPH-3), the Markdown report (PROD-2) and the onboarding census (DSN-4) all render an empty module map even though the data exists.
Deliverable: after the analyze phase in crates/core/src/learn.rs, call crate::modules::build(&index) and store the result in Analysis.modules / Analysis.module_edges before analysis::save, so the artifact and its round-trip carry the tree. Set module node loc/symbols from the rolled-up Index data (modules::build already does this) and do not duplicate any of CORE-4's logic.
Tests (required): learn() on fixtures/sample yields a non-empty modules list with at least one Submodule edge and a File node per indexed source; a 2-dir fixture yields the expected Crate/Dir/File shape; an empty repo yields empty vectors (no panic); analysis::save -> load round-trip preserves modules and module_edges byte-for-byte in value equality.
Verify hook: after learn on fixtures/sample, `grep -c '"modules"' <root>/.repowalk/analysis.json` > 0 AND the modules list length equals the File-node count asserted in the test.
Owner files: crates/core/src/learn.rs (+ tests). Do NOT touch modules.rs (CORE-4), analysis.rs (frozen), or GUI.

Added `let (modules, module_edges) = crate::modules::build(&idx);` after the analyze loop and before analysis::save, stored verbatim (modules::build already sorted/deterministic - no re-sort/filter); removed the now-obsolete old.modules/old.module_edges carry-over. 4 new unit tests. Did not touch modules.rs/analysis.rs/pipeline.rs/store.rs or other test files.
- Progress phases unchanged: the build is folded into the existing analyze->cache boundary, no sixth phase.
- fixtures/sample (6 indexed sources, flat layout, root crate "sample"): 7 module nodes = 1 Crate + 6 File (one File node per source); 8 module_edges = 6 Submodule + 2 Import (a.rs->b.rs, b.rs->a.rs).
- Verify hook: after learn on fixtures/sample, analysis.json grep -c "modules" = 1 (>0); modules list length = 7 (1 Crate + 6 File).
